import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    B = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]

    costs = []
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if a[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if even == odd:
            costs.append(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]))

    costs.sort()
    ans = 0
    for cost in costs:
        if cost <= B:
            ans += 1
            B -= cost
        else:
            break

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
